Info.name: The Name
Info.info: You need to name your farm!

0.msg: Hi there! I'm Clara.\nAre you my new assistant? I'll be expecting my mochachino latte at 11:07 every morning. Do not wake me up a moment before that or...

1.msg: Wait, are you the farm owner? Oh my, you're much more... is shabby a mean word? I hope you'll at least come up with a new name for the place.

2.msg: Don't make it too... hillbilly-ish. This farm is very chic and important, like me. Just come up with something around six letters long.

0.msg: I suppose I can stand to work on a farm with a name like something out of my grandmother's country outhouse. As long as you promise to put up some decorations...

Info.name: Humble Beginnings
Info.info: Welcome to Monster Life!

0.msg: Your farm is ready to go!

1.msg: I guess you're expecting me to tell you what to do around here. Typical.\nFollow me, and try not to fall in love.

2.msg: This place is pretty pathetic right now. Your house doesn't even have a staircase waterfall!\nI suppose everybody starts somewhere...

3.msg: Maybe things will look better with a building. Here, I've been storing this one in my wardrobe warehouse. I'll allow you to use it.

4.msg: You know, instead of us having conversations, why don't I just give you little missions to complete? That way I can feel powerful and you have to do things for me. It's win-win, really.

0.msg: Your first mission: talk to me. A lot. More. Now tell me how good this outfit looks. Okay, that's good.

1.msg: Here is the house I promised you. This type of building is all the rage in Henesys, which I suppose is good if you enjoy being a commoner.

2.msg: Press the Decorate Farm button on the bottom left. You'll need to select the first tab and find that house to place it.

Info.name: Farm Hero
Info.info: Now put it on your farm, and you'll have a little reminder of my generosity every time you look at it.

0.msg: I thought you were going to build that Henesys Homestead I gave you... It was to be my monument!

1.msg: Okay, I'll give you one more chance before I set my hair on fire. Go to Decorate Farm on the bottom left and select the Henesys Homestead from the first tab.

2.msg: Click on the house, then select a place on your farm to build.

3.msg: Okay, I know it won't be as beautiful as if I were to do it, but go ahead.

0.msg: Just think, in a few months, you'll look back at that rickety little shack and think, 'why didn't I go into high finance trading?'

1.msg: Luckily, even ugly buildings bring in the Waru, which is money here.

2.msg: Make sure to collect all the Warus you can. The conversion rate is terrible, but it's very exclusive.

Info.name: Waru, Waru, Won't You?
Info.info: And, if you're the type that likes to think about numbers or building safety, you can open the information window on any building to see more about it.

0.msg: Remember when I told you that you could harvest Waru from buildings?\nGood, because I could use an advance on my salary...

1.msg: Buildings generate a new batch of Warus every 10 minutes, and once their bank is full, they won't generate any more until you clear it out.

2.msg: Look, you'll figure it out, can you just try getting Warus from the house?

3.msg: When you see the alert icon over the building, it's ready to collect. Collect them on a regular basis, and I'll finally be able to afford that diamond-studded shaving kit I've been eying.

4.msg: Click on the building, open the information window, then hit Harvest.

0.msg: Yes! Now the Russian mob won't come and...\nI mean, keep collecting that Waru!

1.msg: You're quite the instruction follower, aren't you? I'll let you keep a little bit of that money for being so good at listening to me.

Info.name: Green with Compliance
Info.info: Let's see if you really do everything I say. Buy me a Green Mushroom Hut.

0.msg: I think you need some pointers on shopping.\nIt's not that you're doing a BAD job, it's just that I do it better than anyone.

1.msg: First, click on that Shop button and find the big Green Mushroom, those are SO in-style right now.

2.msg: Now, buy it! Don't worry about money, you should have enough and we're splurging today.

3.msg: Now put it on your farm. It'll make that Henesys Homestead look better by proxy.

0.msg: That shopping lesson is going to cost you, especially now that you're going to be making more money.

Info.name: Mystical Monster Boxes
Info.info: Open Up Some Monster Boxes.

0.msg: Your farm looks way less awful now, but don't you want some adorable little monsters? That's sort of like, most of the point.

1.msg: I'm going to tell you a little story now, about the birdloks and the beezors, which are basically just birds and bees, but terrifying. Anyway, both of them come out of Monster Boxes, just like every other monster on the farm.

2.msg: That mega-hunk, Dr. Jules, sent over a Monster Box for you to try out. He's so dreamy, but he spends all of his time studying Monsters instead of those 'How to Love Your Clara' books I sent him.

3.msg: Now, you never know what kind of monster you'll find inside a box. Sometimes they're sweet, sometimes they're just full of spiders. It's a thrilling mystery.

0.msg: Why don't you open the box Julesy sent over and see what's inside? I hope it doesn't spit acid like the last one he sent me.

Info.name: Lookin' for Love
Info.info: Sadly, monsters need attention, which always manages to detract from me, but you'll need to right-click on them to Nurture their feelings.

0.msg: The monsters on your farm are a lot like me... they need constant approval and a steady diet of high-end merchandise to stay alive.

1.msg: I suppose they really just need the attention.\nMaybe I'd better teach you how to give it to them.

2.msg: If you haven't already opened that Monster Box, you'll need to do it now. Go to Decorate Farm, then go to the Gift Boxes on the second tab.

3.msg: Let's see what you get. I hope it knows how to make a decent caprese salad.

4.msg: Once you have a monster, right-click on it and press the Nurture button to tell it how proud you are to be picking up its poops.

5.msg: Your farm does best when your monsters are happy, so be liberal with your compliments. You could start now by telling me what kind of diamonds my eyes remind you of. I like to think they're princess cut.

0.msg: That monster looks happy. I'm trying not to crush it in a jealous rage.

1.msg: I'd better go see Dr. Jules. Don't stop working on your farm, all right?

Info.name: Orange You Gonna Buy That?
Info.info: It's about time for you to build an Orange Mushroom House. Get to it, will you?

0.msg: Hi! You that new farmer?

1.msg: I'm Paolo, and this here's my dog-slash-personal-DJ-chef, Kibbles.

2.msg: Woof, woof! (I am a dog!)

3.msg: Ha ha, Kibbles, you are smarter than people.\nAnyway, where's Clara at? She was supposed to come help me clean the jellyfish out of my refrigerator. You would not believe how much they like peanut butter.

4.msg: Have you learned to make buildings yet? I feel like your farm could use an Orange Mushroom House to make it more like the greasy diner in my night-terrors.

5.msg: You've got enough scratch to buy that now. Go to the shop and tear it up!

0.msg: I would eat one of those if it was not so offensive to the mushroom tourists that are staying in my guest house.

Info.name: Forest of Excitement
Info.info: Now I want you to add some greenery to your farm. I want it to be like a magical forest, except on a farm!

0.msg: You need to breathe some exuberance into this dull farm, like I did with that sad goldfish I found in my pocket.

1.msg: What I mean is you have to decorate! You can do simple stuff, like some 18th century Mongolian Vajrayana paintings or a few flowers from the convenience store.

2.msg: Woof, woof! (I will pee on all of those things!)

3.msg: Kibbles, you do not know how to decorate.

4.msg: The first step is to... I actually do not know anything about this, but I bet it's just like building houses. Now build me a Lil' Pine Tree.

0.msg: Is that what a pine tree looks like? Maybe I was thinking of a gas station.

1.msg: This majestic tree is making me feel majestic. I bet it will make your monsters feel majestic too, and that means your farm will do better. Trust me. Farming is all about majesty.

2.msg: Oh! It's time for Kibbles to go to his afternoon improv classes. You're gonna be in a moderately successful romantic comedy one day, aren't you boy?

Info.name: Pathfinder
Info.info: Your monsters need paths or they'll get lost!

0.msg: Hey, my name's Aya. I'm here for my community service. You the boss?

1.msg: What's with the slack jaw? You think fairies can't work on a farm? Huh?!

2.msg: Sorry, my probation officer says I've got a lip on me... Hey, what's the deal with your front lawn? It's kind of a dump.

3.msg: You should put up some paths out there... Or you could just stick an old car on some cinder blocks if you want to keep up the whole 'I don't care' look you've got going.

4.msg: Two minutes on the job and I'm already in charge... hit the Decorate Farm section and select one of the Paths from your options.

5.msg: Keep in mind that you will get the road network effect if you build roads around buildings or decorations.\nDon't forget, to receive the road network effect, the roads need to be connected to My House!

0.msg: What? You want to know more about the road effect?

1.msg: Okay, I'll explain.\nThe road effect is a bonus effect for buildings and decorations close to any road connected to My House.

2.msg: Remember, buildings will generate Waru in proportion to the number of nearby roads, and buildings with nice decorations will be rewarded with Aesthetic Points.

3.msg: You don't have to put down any Paths, but they'll make the place look at a lot less horrible.

4.msg: Hey, you've got this, right? Can you just write an hour down on my time card? I gotta go meet a buddy behind the convenience store. Oh, and I guess you can have some of this money I was supposed to bring you to buy stuff.

Info.name: Forest of Excitement 2
Info.info: That one tree you've got is looking pretty sad. You should plant two more so it's not lonely.

0.msg: Phew, I hope I didn't keep you waiting. Oh wait, reverse that.

1.msg: I'm glad I missed Paolo. Sometimes he just... stares at me. Don't get me wrong, I love the attention, but I really think he's trying to figure out if he could take me in a fight.

2.msg: Did he make you plant that tree? I bet he thought it was going to be a gas station again.

3.msg: Why did you only plant one? Aren't you afraid that all your neighbors will see and realize how unimportant you are? You need to plant more.

4.msg: Having one Lil Pine Tree is like telling the world you're willing to settle for honorary mention. Buy two more and plant them before anybody notices.

0.msg: Now that I see the two of them together, I feel like they're taking the focus off of me.

1.msg: You know that I, and your monsters, need a nice environment to thrive, right? You need to plan ahead or you're going to run into layout problems, and any discomfort I experience will be taken out of your safe.

Info.name: Combo Number 1
Info.info: Use the menu to move to the Study, or use the Mirror to find monsters you'd like to combine. Just right-click, then hit Combine. You can also talk to me to visit a random farm.

0.msg: Did Bosco send you? I'll have his money, I just need a little more...

1.msg: You're... not here to hit me in the knees, are you? I'm Dr. Julian Von Jules, professional monster biologist and amateur mixologist to the stars.

2.msg: Come on, let's get this monster party going! You'll never get anywhere in farming if you don't start combining.

3.msg: I blame the Black Mage for all the violent monsters we've been seeing. I also blame him for the botched surgery that got my medical license revoked.

4.msg: Keep your farm neat and tidy, like my accountant keeps that one set of books I let the government see. Both of those situations pay off in the end.

5.msg: Monsters from the same farm should never be combined, it's terrible for their self-esteem.

6.msg: You'll need to wait until at least level 3 before you can combine new monsters too.

7.msg: Finally, don't let your monsters get too corrupted by the outside world, or they won't be able to combine. You don't want them turning all jaded and mopey like a bunch of liberal arts majors.

8.msg: Now, use the Mirror in my Study to visit a random farm.

9.msg: When you get there, first check the house for any undercover detectives. Then, leave one of my business cards on the counter, in case they need a mixologist for a party. THEN, right-click on a monster and select Combine.

10.msg: A monster list appears when you are done combining. Select a monster you want to add to the farm.

11.msg: I usually don't let strangers watch the monster combining process, but you look like the kind of person I can blackmail if I need to. Try combining one of your monsters with someone else's.

0.msg: Look at those monsters combine. It's almost... OH MY GOODNESS is that what it looks like?! I think I'm going to barf!

1.msg: Do you at least like your new monster? Personally, I can't stand the things. They all just want food and medical attention.

2.msg: One little tip, really let your monsters know which ones are your favorites. A little competition is always good, and your love can be a powerful motivator.

3.msg: Let's see, I told you about withholding love, breaking into farm-houses... Darnit, I was supposed to leave an hour ago, but there are a few more things.

4.msg: Now, usually your monster combinations will spit out something similar, but every once in a while you'll get a real genetic freak.

5.msg: The same thing happens with high-grade or high-level monsters. They sometimes create a monster better than them.

6.msg: Just in case you're thinking that you can't get your desired monster because you already have too many...\nHa ha, don't worry about that, my friend! The number of monsters to choose from will increase in direct proportion with the number of monsters you have.

7.msg: All this monster combining talk is really starting to put me to sleep. What will it take for you to leave me alone for a while?

Info.name: Triple Mushroom Farm
Info.info: Once you build Red Mushroom Manor, you'll have all the mushroom houses. Then you can make a stew!

0.msg: I heard Jules gave you a lesson for free. You're so lucky... Can you tell that I'm holding back a scream right now?

1.msg: The only cure for my homicidal rage is a shiny new thing. You should build Red Mushroom Manor.

2.msg: Buy me Red Mushroom Manor, and I'll stop powdering your pillows with borax.

0.msg: Look how beautiful it is! Almost as rosy as my cheeks!

Info.name: Hungry Hot
Info.info: It's hot. Time for Big Pine Trees and more shade!

0.msg: Hungry Hot

1.msg: Why is your farm always so hot? Are we on the face of the sun?

2.msg: Look, I don't care if I'm breaking a court order. I can't work in these conditions. My wings are going to curl up and light on fire.

3.msg: I'm going to raid your refrigerator, and I ain't coming back outside until you plant some bigger trees.

0.msg: You're gonna need to go to the grocery store...

1.msg: It's still hot though... and I think that's your fault.

Info.name: Monster Inspector
Info.info: Go to another farm and play with some monsters, because your friends are probably being neglectful.

0.msg: Was Aya throwing a fit about the heat? Just like her to complain about cleansing her perfect pores while I suffer from the increased pollen count...

1.msg: Let's talk more about your farm before I pull all my fingernails off in a rage.

2.msg: You've been to other farms by now, right? You know, if you waste some of your precious time playing with monsters on other farms, people will think you're a good person.

3.msg: That way they'll owe you favors and have to do things for you.

4.msg: I think you might even get some benefits from the monsters, but mostly I do it for the popularity. Dr. Jules really likes generous women...

5.msg: Speaking of which, would you go over to Jules's study, visit another farm, and play with monsters in front of him? It'll really get me some brownie points.

6.msg: Right-click on other monsters and select Play. While you're doing that, I'm going to fake a neck injury and get him to look at it.

0.msg: Good work manipulating your friends! Now they'll feel obligated to come play with your mangy monsters.

1.msg: Even the most casual encounter can lead to a good friendship.

2.msg: If other people visit your farm, you should go to theirs and leave them a thank-you note. One-upsmanship is an important skill on the farm.

3.msg: Speaking of which, you can't combine or play with more than one monster in each category each day.

4.msg: You'll really have to plan to make sure you get them all, and the competition for your love should make you feel wonderful about yourself.

Info.name: Hey There, Good Lookin'
Info.info: The appearance of your farm affects your monsters. Get your Aesthetic Points to 100.

0.msg: I think we need to have a talk about your farm and the face you're showing the world...

1.msg: Did you know there is a system for measuring how beautiful things are? They're called Aesthetic Points and they may be THE most important invention of the 21st century.

2.msg: Look at that green clover up there, next to those other, less important things.

3.msg: That number tells you how beautiful, and therefore how worthwhile of a person you are. Or your farm, I mean. Whatever.

4.msg: Every decoration and building you have adds to that number, and it will go down if you take any of them away. So don't ever do that. Ever.

5.msg: Decorative items add a lot more points than buildings, even if they don't generate any money.

6.msg: I want to see if you can get your Aesthetic Points up to 100. Think how much everyone will love me if I'm seen on a beautiful farm. This is my chance to be a star!

7.msg: Oh, I guess you get some buff things too. You can hover over the clover to see them, or you could just sit there and think about how talented I am.

0.msg: I'm going to take so many pictures of myself here!

1.msg: You really have to keep increasing your Aesthetic Points. Never settle for being pretty when you could be gorgeous. The rewards just get better and better, trust me.

2.msg: Keep decorating your farm and we can both enjoy the benefits.

Info.name: Picture Perfect
Info.info: You can register your profile image by clicking Profile on the left. Give it a go!

0.msg: Now that your confidence is up, you should add a picture to your profile.

1.msg: This could be your chance to share your face with someone important... like me!

2.msg: It's very easy. I change mine three times a day! Just click Profile on the upper left and select your best snapshot.

3.msg: Add something that will impress everyone, like something on a water ski, or maybe something with a D-list celebrity that's less attractive than you are.

4.msg: Just don't put up anything naughty or mean. I'm legally obligated to tell you that after the whole anti-porpoise movement I started.

0.msg: I'll come back when you're done! This is personal business.

Info.name: Relocation Revolution
Info.info: You can move your buildings around with the Relocate button. A little change can keep things fresh!

0.msg: It's good to know how to move things around. That way, you can confuse the paparazzi.

1.msg: To rearrange your buildings, move to the Decorate Farm tab and click Relocate.

2.msg: You'll see a grid of lines to help you line things up nicely.

3.msg: Click on any building to pick it up, then just move it around, rotate it, whatever makes it look best.

4.msg: Any Paths you try to relocate will be erased. That way you can put down new ones!

0.msg: You can relocate things any time, so rethink your designs on a regular basis. You have to stay on the cutting edge of farm trends.

1.msg: If you cancel out of a relocation, the building will go back to your inventory.  Pretty useful, huh?

Info.name: Monster Barn
Info.info: When your farm gets full, you can store monsters in the Monster Barn.

0.msg: Your farm is looking a little less cringe-inducing.

1.msg: What are you doing with all your excess monsters? I usually just throw mine in the garbage cans at the supermarket.

2.msg: I've heard some people use a Monster Barn to store extra monsters.

3.msg: I suppose a Monster Barn would be pretty useful, but it has a lot of rules.

4.msg: For one, any monsters in storage don't give you any potential bonuses.

5.msg: Also, their combination and potential time limits still apply, even when they're stored away.

6.msg: I guess it's better than just letting them run into the woods like I did with that rabid hypnobadger.

7.msg: You can have this Monster Barn. I'll just put it in your things... If your watch goes missing while I'm in there, it wasn't me.

Info.name: Good Job!
Info.info: Finish the repeatable quest 10 times, and I'll give you a little something good.

0.msg: All ten times! Good job.

1.msg: As a superior, I can tell you that your work is benefiting my off-time greatly.

2.msg: Now take this and leave me to my sunbathing.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 2
Info.info: You hit level 2! Time for a gift.

0.msg: Hey bozo, what am I supposed to do here?

1.msg: What, you never seen a fairy before? Well get used to it. The name's Aya.

2.msg: Here's the deal. I'm working your farm, but I got rules...

3.msg: First up, : no ordering me around, no talking smack about fairies, no comments on my cute little wings or my loud voice.

4.msg: Oh, and I brought you this stupid present for reaching level 2. There's like a monster or something in there. I don't know, I'm going on break.

5.msg: I gotta go.

0.msg: Now that you're Level 2, you can buy an Orange Mushroom House and Lil Pine Trees.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 3
Info.info: You hit level 3! Time for a gift.

0.msg: Ugh, did you level up again? Sheesh.

1.msg: You hit level 3, you know what you're doing now...

2.msg: You can build yourself a Red Mushroom Manner, a Sturdy Straw House, a Pine Tree, even one of those Orange Mini Mushrooms...

3.msg: You can even keep three monsters now. You're a pro, right?

0.msg: I brought you this money too because you're soooo greeeat... Must be nice.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 4
Info.info: You hit level 4! Time for a gift.

0.msg: Hi! It's me! Didn't you miss me? Huh?!

1.msg: Oh, wow, you're Level 4 already! Good job, really, that's just... wow.

2.msg: I bet your farms, going to get all kinds of golly-gee buildings and decorations!

3.msg: Oh, and more precious little smushy-faced monsters. Hooray and joy!

4.msg: Look, I even brought you a gift, because I'm so... what do people feel? I don't know, proud?

0.msg: Psst... if anybody asks, I was here last night and I'm terrified of crowbars. Okay, right? Buddy? Pal? We're cool, right?

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 7
Info.info: You hit level 7! Time for a gift.

0.msg: Hey, now that you're level 7, you can finally upgrade that shack you live in!

1.msg: You can get the upgrade from the shop. Maybe you could get a flat screen and a fairy-sized hammock while you're at it?

0.msg: Look, I don't usually like being nice to you, but I'll help you out on this one since it helps me too. Here's some money.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 32
Info.info: You hit level 32! Time for a gift.

0.msg: Level 32, huh? You think you're big now? Huh, boss?! HUH?! You're not so big...

1.msg: I mean, I guess you're bigger than me, but...

2.msg: Whatever! I brought you a gift. Don't think that means I like you!

0.msg: I hope the monster in there takes over your house, and then you'll have to come see me, and you'll be like, 'Oh, Aya, please stop the monster from using my nice sheets!' But I won't. I won't do it.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 34
Info.info: You hit level 34! Time for a gift.

0.msg: Level 34 rhymes with hardcore. I think I'll use that for my new rap persona, MC Fairy Dust!

1.msg: Passion, fashion, your face needs a bashin'... I float up in the club and all these suckas eat my rations... Record contract, here I come!

2.msg: That performance was worth at least 200,000 Warus. So here's what's going to happen. I brought 400,000 Warus for you, but I'm going to keep half.

0.msg: I'll be back tomorrow for another show. Don't lose that money.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 36
Info.info: You hit level 36! Time for a gift.

0.msg: So, about that whole rap star plan I had going...

1.msg: Now that you're level 36, I was thinking maybe you could call some people for me, maybe put in a good word with the rap moguls?

2.msg: Look, I even brought you a gift.

3.msg: It's a good one too! I took it out of my dad's garage. It's the Secret Garden!

0.msg: Since I'm being so nice, how about you maybe call all of your fancy producer friends with their shiny cars, and tell them you have the next big sensation eating sandwiches in your kitchen. Also, I'm going to make a sandwich.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 38
Info.info: You hit level 38! Time for a gift.

0.msg: You gotta hide me! I don't care if it's your Level 38 celebration or not!

1.msg: This guy named Big Peezy sent me a fancy monster box, and now he wants me to actually cut an album with him! I can't do that! I'm not a rapper!

2.msg: I didn't think you actually HAD any producer friends! Why didn't you tell me?!

0.msg: Ah, geez, there's a paparazzo in your bushes. I gotta hide!

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 39
Info.info: You hit level 39! Time for a gift.

0.msg: I've decided to embrace the whole rising star thing. I mean, I can rap, right? How hard could it be?

1.msg: All I have to do is buy a big fur coat, talk smack about some reality tv star online, maybe hire a couple of dancers... boom, superstar.

2.msg: I'd also better give out some elaborate gifts I can't afford... like this super-slick monster box.

0.msg: I got special monsters like I got phat beats! I'll come back when you're 40 and we'll get some phat eats! Yeah... I got this.

Info.name: The Leveling Fairy: 40
Info.info: You're a Master Farmer!

0.msg: WOOOOOOOOooooooo!

1.msg: So, you're 40. I guess that means my community service is officially over.

2.msg: It's about time!

3.msg: I mean, it's not like I hate it here. This isn't the worst trash heap a hip-hop megastar like myself could be chilling in. It ain't a solid gold jaccuzzi or anything, but...

0.msg: Look, I think you need one last thing to spruce your swagger.

1.msg: You gotta get straight Luminous up in this piece!

2.msg: He's tiny, angry, and full of all kinds of emotions. Just like me. He's even got a slick cane he carries around.

3.msg: You get Luminous here, and I'll forget all about those times I called you a pathetic dirt-shuffler behind your back.

Info.name: Monsterer Achieved
Info.info: You completed 20 Achievements! Here's your gift.

0.msg: You earned 20 achievements. That's pretty achievable.
Don't you want something to celebrate? You should.

1.msg: Not all gifts are completely useless, you know?

2.msg: Try not to get eaten by anything too horrible out there!

Info.name: Overachiever
Info.info: You earned 45 achievements! You should get more stuff.

0.msg: You earned 45 achievements. How did you achieve so much?
I kept looking for something else to give.

1.msg: I found few of these in the storage.

2.msg: I forgot why I even got them in the first place.

3.msg: Eh, this should be all right.

Info.name: Monster Overlord
Info.info: Wow, you completed 70 achievements! That's definitely worth me caring.

0.msg: You earned 70 achievements. You're such an overachiever.
This is your reward.

1.msg: I'd rather just give you one at a time. That's easier for me.

Info.name: All Achievements Complete
Info.info: You finished all the achievements! You'll have to find something new to validate your existence.

0.msg: You completed 101 achievements. What's left to achieve?
This is special just for you.

1.msg: I'll be seeing you around.

Info.name: We Meet Again
Info.info: You were reunited with monsters you released? Was there a lot of weeping?

0.msg: You were reunited with monsters you released? Did any of them try to cut you?

1.msg: I need to find something to remember the occasion...

2.msg: Here, take this. It's to remember the occasion.

Info.name: Banking
Info.info: I know you're rich now, but you should save up for my birthday.

0.msg: Wow, you're really rich.
I'll give you a little something to remember the occasion.

1.msg: You should remember this moment, especially when you inevitably hit the poor house.

2.msg: Maybe I've said too much. Anyway, congratulations.

Info.name: Quest Keeper
Info.info: You finished all the story quests! Aren't we fun?

0.msg: You finished all the story quests! Why did you do that?!
It must've been a long trip. Judging by the dirt, I mean.

1.msg: I'll give you something to remember the occasion.

Info.name: Master Pen Pal
